evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B04G1MEwY ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CDY277D3?lv=shuf&btn_type=ss&gaOptInStatus=true&btn_ref=srctok-...&channelId=704&plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven ...)
evidence_observations.interpretation: Stable destination. Re-fetched on 2026-11-14 it ended at the same ASIN with the same product page; the earlier 'fallback' reading was withdrawn after a control test (see E-06). The mapping is observed behaviour, not documented intent.

evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B02NbDxp3 ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09B7SB46R?...plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven ...)
evidence_observations.interpretation: A different destination from E-01, one per submitted link - which is what a per-link mapping looks like, and equally what a fallback looks like. E-06 and E-07 discriminate between the two.

evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B00hJ57DV ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DKYBTPH?...plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt | TurboFry 4-in-1 ...)
evidence_observations.interpretation: A third distinct destination, one per submitted link. Combined with E-06 and E-07 this reads as an individually tracked source link, not an arbitrary fallback.

evidence_observations.observation: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B04G1MEwY , https://www.amazon.com/dp/B02NbDxp3 and https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00hJ57DV each returned Amazon's "Sorry! We couldn't find that page" error page when fetched on 2026-11-13 and again on 2026-11-14.
evidence_observations.interpretation: No catalog record exists for any of the three tokens as given.

evidence_observations.observation: Each token was measured against the ASIN identifier definition (10 characters): B04G1MEwY=9, B02NbDxp3=9, B00hJ57DV=9. Each is alphanumeric, so only the length fails.
evidence_observations.interpretation: Pattern is consistent with a one-character truncation, but the missing character is not recoverable and was NOT guessed.

evidence_observations.observation: CONTROL: a bare, untagged GET https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CDY277D3 - a valid 10-character ASIN - returned the real CHEFMAN 6 Qt product page, and Amazon rewrote its own links to ?lv=shuf&channelId=500&plpRedirect=mhFallback.
evidence_observations.interpretation: plpRedirect=mhFallback and lv=shuf are emitted on ordinary valid product-page loads. They are not evidence of a fallback and do not distinguish a valid ASIN from a bad token. This is the control the earlier conclusion lacked.

evidence_observations.observation: The per-link token btn_ref=srctok-<hex> was identical on same-day re-fetch of each link, and differed between 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-14 for the same link (B04G1MEwY: srctok-1e229870efde5acf -> srctok-1f979f303a4b5691). The destination ASIN did not change on any fetch across five sessions and two days.
evidence_observations.interpretation: A rotating source-attribution token on a fixed destination is the behaviour of a tracked source link. A shuffle would change the destination. The token must not be treated as a stable identifier; only the destination ASIN is.
